title: SyncManifest
description: Full library manifest used for initial synchronisation or full resync

sync_id.description: Unique identifier for this sync operation

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was generated

tracks.description: Full list of track objects in the library

albums.description: Full list of album objects in the library

artists.description: Full list of artist objects in the library

playlists.description: Full list of playlist objects in the library

total_tracks.description: Total number of tracks in the manifest

total_albums.description: Total number of albums in the manifest

total_artists.description: Total number of artists in the manifest

total_playlists.description: Total number of playlists in the manifest
